operatorSecrets.name: DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL
operatorSecrets.purpose: Direct database connection used only by explicit target-validated migration and inspection commands.

runtimeSecrets.name: APP_URL
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Public application URL used in generated portal links.

runtimeSecrets.name: SITE_LOCKED
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional maintenance lock. Set true only during controlled maintenance windows.

runtimeSecrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Session and auth signing secret.

runtimeSecrets.name: AUTH_TRUST_HOST
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Trust production host headers for auth workflows.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_AUTH_PROVIDER
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional identity-provider selector. Keep legacy until Cognito cutover is approved.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_AUTH_MODE
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional auth mode. Use legacy as the rollback value and cognito only for approved preview/cutover testing.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_OWNER_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Exclusive initial Super Admin identity for Cognito bootstrap.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_REGION
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito user pool AWS region when Cognito auth mode is enabled.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito user pool identifier when Cognito auth mode is enabled.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_USER_POOL_DOMAIN
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito hosted UI or custom domain used for authorization and logout.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito app client identifier.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_CLIENT_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito app client secret when the app client is configured with one.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_ISSUER
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Expected Cognito JWT issuer.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_JWKS_URL
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito JWKS endpoint used for JWT signature verification.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_REDIRECT_URI
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Registered Cognito callback URL for the current environment.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_LOGOUT_URI
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Registered Cognito logout destination for the current environment.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_STAFF_IDP_NAME
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Cognito identity provider name for Google Workspace staff federation.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_COGNITO_ALLOWED_STAFF_DOMAIN
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Allowed Google Workspace staff email domain.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: HMAC secret for Cognito session cookie signing.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional Cognito session cookie name.

runtimeSecrets.name: DATABASE_URL
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Runtime-only Postgres connection URL. Scope independently for Production AWS RDS and protected Preview Neon.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_REGION
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Default AWS region for storage and provider operations.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
runtimeSecrets.purpose: AWS access key for SES/SNS/S3-compatible operations.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
runtimeSecrets.purpose: AWS secret key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_STORAGE_REGION
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Evidence and order document S3 bucket region.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_STORAGE_BUCKET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Evidence and order document S3 bucket name.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional S3-compatible endpoint when not using AWS S3 native endpoint.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_EVIDENCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Shared HMAC secret for evidence upload and malware callbacks.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional dedicated HMAC secret for storage upload callbacks.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_MALWARE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional dedicated HMAC secret for malware scan callbacks.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_SES_REGION
runtimeSecrets.purpose: AWS SES email region.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_SES_FROM_EMAIL
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Verified SES sender address.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Shared HMAC secret for email, SMS, and phone provider callbacks.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional dedicated HMAC secret for email callbacks.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_SMS_REGION
runtimeSecrets.purpose: AWS SMS/Pinpoint region when SMS is enabled.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_PINPOINT_APPLICATION_ID
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Pinpoint application identifier when Pinpoint SMS is selected.

runtimeSecrets.name: AWS_SNS_ORIGINATION_NUMBER
runtimeSecrets.purpose: SNS origination number when SNS SMS is selected.

runtimeSecrets.name: NOTARIX_SMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
runtimeSecrets.purpose: Optional dedicated HMAC secret for SMS callbacks.
